source.title: Structural Design Challenges of Shanghai Tower
source.institution: Thornton Tomasetti; NTUA EEME invited-speaker proceedings host
source.publication_date_precision: Year inferred from PDF creation 2014-09-16; exact conference publication day not verified
source.type: Designer-authored technical paper, institutional proceedings copy
source.locator: PDFp13 Fig8 (Gensler section); PDFp14 Fig9 (Thornton current and original structural models)
source.version: 2014 file; Fig8 may contain an earlier architectural datum/version; no construction revision number
source.original_units: Dimensions apparently mm; elevation labels m, OCR/manual digit ambiguity
source.limit: Embedded section 953x931 pixels; exact 3D crown clipping coordinates not published; avoid claiming as-built accuracy

observed_topology.crown: Open crown with split-parabolic outline (Gensler 2014 p19); no horizontal cap
observed_topology.vertical_trusses: Outer façade gravity load transfers directly to L118
observed_topology.radial_struts: Lateral wind load transfers to core framing
observed_topology.kicker_trusses: Support inner face and brace outer trusses above L129 roof
observed_topology.corner_bays: Vertically braced bays at three corners, horizontal floor truss every other floor
observed_topology.tmd: Design locates 1100-ton TMD above core at L125; final mass/version conflict remains

measurement_protocol.view: Architectural section, no camera perspective correction needed for projected drawing coordinates; cannot reconstruct out-of-section 3D coordinates
measurement_protocol.x_scale: Three dimension bays printed 9850 or 9950 (low resolution ambiguity), not adopted for definitive plan coordinates
measurement_protocol.z_scale: Right vertical dimension 39530 mm spans image y106 to y445
measurement_protocol.anchor: Model highest point 632m is independently confirmed; graph y106 is normalized to that value. Absolute offset between this section edition and public height is unresolved.
measurement_protocol.total_model_height_error_m: ±1.5 (includes blur, calibration, source datum/version; not surveyed tolerance)
measurement_protocol.sampling: Manual centerline points from original embedded image, enlarged only for viewing; interpolation adds no new resolution

implementation_candidate.name: asymmetric_split_parabola_open_perimeter
implementation_candidate.coordinate: Existing 2014 mother-profile local XY and WP1 axis. s=normalized arclength along the remaining five arcs after full K2 corner exclusion. s direction and building north not recovered.
assumptions: Mapping one section outer rim samples to s endpoints is underdetermined and chosen as fit interface.
Lowest station s=0.5 chosen as a mapping convention; source does not specify circumferential minimum station.
Two unequal ends preserve a split outline but its seam angles and geographic position are not surveyed.
The entire K2 arc exclusion is previous conservative guard, not the actual V-groove boundary.
Use all heights only as approximate form fit; no datum mixing disguised as precise geometry.
implementation_candidate.uncertainty: Section anchors ±1.5m; full circumferential interpolation/orientation unbounded from this section, conservatively label all crown cladding DERIVED and permit CAD replacement.
implementation_candidate.upper_surface: Clip vertical/twisting shell at z_top(s); do not add planar top cover. Inner rain-collector branch needs separate geometry and coordinates, not inferred as exterior low point.
implementation_candidate.member_positions: Only schematic topology from Fig9 until plan/erection coordinates are acquired; section/member sizes not verified
